# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / comments.input (adapted to Lezer)
// Package line 1 group 1
// Package line 2 group 1

// Package line 1 - group 2
// Package line 2 - group 2
package comments

// Emit line 1 group 1

// Emit line 1 group 2
// Emit line 2 group 2
{
    // Inside Emit
}

a: 3 // a line comment

b: 4 // line comment that is last in the file.
cc: 555 // align comments

// don't simplify
a: {
    b: 2
}

// simplify
a: {
    b: c: {
        d: 1
    }
}

// unchanged
a: b: [1]

// don't simplify
a: b: {
    c: 2
}

// don't simplify: collapsing would move this comment from c to d
a: b: c: {
    d: 2
}

m: {
}
m: {
    // empty with comment
}

// Issue #478
struct1: {
    // This is a comment

    // This is a comment

    // Another comment

    something: {
    }
    // extra comment
}

struct2: {
    // This is a comment

    // This is a comment

    // Another comment
    something: {
    }

    // extra comment
}

list1: [
    // Comment1

    // Comment2

    // Another comment
    {
    },

    // Comment 3
]

list2: [
    // foo
]

list3: [
    // foo

    // bar
]

list4: [
  1, // number
  a.b, // selector
  (a), // paren
  +1, // unary
  a[0], // index
  a[2:3],  // slice
  strings.Sort([1, 2]), // call

  a.b,
  // under selector

  a.b,
  // multiple
  // under

  // selector
]

funcArg1: foo(
    // Comment1

    // Comment2
    3

    // Comment3
)

funcArg2: foo(
    // Comment1

    // Comment2

    3
    // Comment3
)

funcArg3: foo(
    2,

    // Comment1

    // Comment2
    3

    // Comment3
)

//	comment including		some tabs


// issue #2567
foo: [
 	bar["baz"], //some comment
]

[
	if true // inline comment
	{}]

{
    // comments
    ... // surrounding

    // an ellipsis

    foo: {
        // some
        [string]: _ // comment
    }
}

// issue #4238
[string]: [
	...string // inline comment without a comma
]
[string]: [
	...string, // inline comment with a comma
]
==>

# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / issue1006.input (adapted to Lezer)
// issue #1006: comments should not be aligned across the opening
// or closing token of a multi-line struct, list, or func call.

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: { // comment
	a: string // comment

	b: string // comment
} | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: [ // comment
	a, // comment

	b, // comment
] | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: f( // comment
	a, // comment

	b, // comment
) | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

==>
